what: Cold loads of each yard on a phone viewport, before (main b0acc6a) and after (this branch).

method.webkit: Playwright 1.49.1 WebKit, iPhone 13 (390x844, DPR 3) unless noted; root URL with localStorage cyStyle=<yard> (the owner's path).
method.chromium: Playwright Chromium (SwiftShader), Pixel 7 (412x839, DPR 2.625), CPU throttled 4x via CDP.
method.nonBlackRatio: share of screenshot pixels with Rec.709 luma > 16 between 20% and 85% of the height (the scene area). A black scene with the yard panel open (first-visit default) measures 0.679.
method.loadMs: navigation to: loading screen gone and, for the desert, window.__desProg().done (every model placed and drawn).
method.gpuEstimateMB: textures (compressed mip bytes, or w*h*4 with mips) + geometry buffers in the scene + render targets (MSAA drawing buffer, composer ping-pong half-float x2, bloom chain). Shadow maps are not included; the desert's on a phone go from 2048^2 to 1536^2 (about 32 MB to 18 MB with depth).
method.jsHeapMB: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage after load (Chromium only; WebKit exposes no heap size). ArrayBuffer stores are outside it, see memory.prefetch.
